newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol posts fall in Q1 net, operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Repsol posts fall in Q1 net, operating profit.

text.p: Results for three months to March,
in billions of pesetas, unless stated:

Refining and Marketing posted operating profit of 22.91 billion pesetas, up 13.1 percent on improved refining margins which compensated for the dismantling of the leaded petrol price capping system in Holland and Germany, the firm said.

The Chemical division saw operating profit rise to 7.25 billion pesetas versus 5.56 billion, on a strong rise in basic chemicals' margin. However derived chemicals' margin fell, as did sales, after a strong rise in the price of raw materials.
Operating results at the Gas arm fell by more than half to 10.94 billion pesetas versus 23.23 billion pesetas.
Total investment rose to 105.56 billion pesetas versus 48.77 billion pesetas one year ago, mainly concentrated in Exploration and Production, Refining and Marketing, and Gas.
